status: conditional analyst estimate; allocation and market data are assumptions, not verified facts
rating_rule: price-only upside >=15% BUY, <=-15% SELL, otherwise HOLD; horizon 2026-12-31, not 12 months

preferred_claim.assumption: Equal participation in residual earnings and distributions, no voting-control premium, minimum preferred thresholds non-binding; not a legal claim valuation.

warnings: Q3 segment book and 26 Nov prices are mixed with a year-end DCF discount anchor; Q4 equity bridge omitted.
Consolidated Kia carrying amount is used as a proxy for its vehicle-segment amount; unverified overlap.
Owners elimination proxy includes intra-group ownership and other consolidation effects; not a fair-value adjustment.
Vehicle EV uses pre-consolidation EBIT and externally reported vehicle sales, an approximate mixture.
Finance and other parent equity at 1.0x are not valuation outcomes; vehicle financial assets besides cash are omitted.
Forecast capex is an accounting scenario and not company investment plan; terminal value dominates.
Preferred allocation assumes equal residual participation, no voting premium and preferred minimums are non-binding.
